tagline: 3CX phone system configuration and Bitrix24 CRM workflows for Cambodian businesses
positioning: One local team for 3CX phone system configuration and Bitrix24 CRM workflows.
description: KHCOLO is a Cambodia-based IT solutions company that configures and supports 3CX phone systems and implements Bitrix24 CRM workflows, with projects in Phnom Penh and Siem Reap by agreement.

partners.scope: We configure and support 3CX for calls, queues, chat and video. Calls, phone numbers and connectivity are supplied separately by your authorized provider.
We implement Bitrix24 CRM, task and contact-center workflows and connect them to 3CX.

principles.title: Local engineers
principles.body: You talk to engineers based in Cambodia, in Khmer or English, not an overseas ticket queue.

principles.title: Implementation and ongoing support
principles.body: The team that designs your setup is the team that answers when something needs attention.

principles.title: Phone system and CRM together
principles.body: 3CX and Bitrix24 configured to work together, with one point of contact for both.

solutionGroups.name: Communications
solutionGroups.summary: 3CX phone system configuration and Bitrix24 CRM, working together.
solutionGroups.need: Reach customers on the channels they use and keep conversations in one place.

solutionGroups.name: Security
solutionGroups.need: Protect your devices and the data moving between your business and its customers.

solutionGroups.name: Cloud & Infrastructure
solutionGroups.need: Run websites and servers on infrastructure you control.

solutionGroups.name: Managed IT
solutionGroups.summary: Preventive maintenance and support for servers, PCs and networks.
solutionGroups.need: Keep everyday IT healthy with a team that already knows your setup.

notes: Partner relationships are as published on the About page (3CX Gold Partner, Yeastar Certified Reseller, Yealink Authorized Reseller, cPanel Hosting Partner) plus the ESET reseller relationship described elsewhere. Confirm each status before launch.
24/7 support is advertised on the current site. It is not used on the new site until the owner confirms which contracts and services it covers.
No street address, office hours or map coordinates were published. LocalBusiness markup is deliberately omitted until confirmed.

Logo is redrawn as vectors from the original colour artwork on khcolo.com: navy letters (#001088) and the blue globe with its diagonal gloss. Owner to supply original vector artwork if available, and confirm the colours.
Bitrix24 appears in the partner strip as "CRM implementation" (what KHCOLO does). If KHCOLO holds an official Bitrix24 partner status, update the wording to that exact tier.
KHCOLO is not registered with TRC or MPTC, so the site describes it as an IT solutions company, not a telecom provider or partner (owner, 4 Nov 2026).
Acronis and Zimbra are no longer offered (owner, 4 Nov 2026). Their pages are removed and the old URLs redirect to IT Maintenance and Hosting & Cloud VPS.
The operating year (2017) is not shown anywhere until it is checked against the company registration licence. The value stays in this file as operatingSince for when it is confirmed.
Service area is shown as Cambodia (nationwide, with on-site installation) rather than listing Phnom Penh and Siem Reap (owner, 4 Nov 2026).
